title: Altinn Studio — Operator
description: The runtime operator (service operator), one per service owner cluster, across the runtime environments. Its controllers run in the elected leader: Maskinporten clients and their key rotation, secret and app code sync, Key Vault sync, Grafana alert routing, CNPG databases and, outside prod, the inactivity scaler. Runs, failures and their duration per controller come from altinn.operator.run.duration (one point per reconcile or pass of a periodic sync, with error.type for a failed one); Maskinporten client states, the inactivity state and leadership from the operator's gauges; outgoing calls from http.client.request.duration; versions, process starts and clusters that stopped reporting from altinn.workload.start_time. All from altinn-studio-metrics, which isn't sampled. Below, for triage, the failed runs from their traces: tail sampling keeps every trace with an error. Service owner comes from altinn.service_owner, which the router in each service owner cluster sets on the resource. Rates use increase_pure() over $__rate_interval divided by its length rather than rate(), so a first failure on a new series shows. Blue markers are each version's first start per environment (90 days of history), orange markers each process start (off by default).

list.name: Deploys (first start of version)
list.textFormat: {{deployment.environment.name}}. Earliest retained process start for this version in the selected clusters (90d history). An upgrade rolls out ring by ring, so later clusters start it later.

panels.title: Operators reporting
panels.description: Operator processes with an altinn.workload.start_time sample in the last minute at the range end, per environment. One per service owner cluster, two during a rollout. Counts processes exporting telemetry, not readiness.

panels.title: Not reporting
panels.description: Service owner clusters (per environment) whose operator reported in the last 24 hours but not in the last 2 minutes: the operator is down or crash-looping, or its telemetry doesn't arrive. The Operators table lists them. A decommissioned cluster shows here for a day.

targets.expr: count by ("deployment.environment.name") (group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (present_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[24h])) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (present_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[2m]))) or (0 * count by ("deployment.environment.name") (group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (present_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[24h]))))

panels.title: No leader
panels.description: Service owner clusters (per environment) whose operator processes report altinn.operator.leader, none of them 1, at the range end. Only the elected leader runs the controllers. A new process reports 0 until it is elected; more than a minute or two is a stuck election.

targets.expr: count by ("deployment.environment.name") (max by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (last_over_time({"altinn.operator.leader", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[1m])) == 0) or (0 * count by ("deployment.environment.name") (last_over_time({"altinn.operator.leader", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[2m])))

panels.title: Stalled syncs
panels.description: Periodic syncs that ran in the last 7 days but had no run without an error recently: 30 minutes for the syncs that poll every 5 to 10 minutes, 25 hours for the daily Maskinporten rotation rollout. Stalled syncs below lists them.

targets.expr: count by ("deployment.environment.name") ((sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"grafanapolicysync|cnpgsync|inactivityscaler|azurekeyvaultsync", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[7d])) > 0) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "error.type"="", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"grafanapolicysync|cnpgsync|inactivityscaler|azurekeyvaultsync", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[30m])) > 0) or (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"maskinporten_rotation_rollout", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[7d])) > 0) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "error.type"="", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"maskinporten_rotation_rollout", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[25h])) > 0)) or (0 * count by ("deployment.environment.name") (last_over_time({"altinn.operator.leader", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[2m])))

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Controller runs that failed over the time range: reconciles and passes of the periodic syncs whose entry span has error.type. From altinn.operator.run.duration, which isn't sampled. No value when no operator reports.

panels.title: Maskinporten not ready
panels.description: MaskinportenClients that aren't ready at the range end: not_ready (the last reconcile failed, also a transient failure; the app's existing credentials keep working until they expire) or unknown (not reconciled yet; a client stuck there points at the controller). From altinn.operator.maskinporten.clients.

panels.title: Operators by service owner
panels.description: One row per service owner cluster and operator version (two during a rollout): the version (service.version, the commit), processes reporting in the last minute, whether the elected leader is among them, when the oldest started, and how many processes started in the time range (a rollout is one; more is a restart or a crash loop). A cluster that reported in the last 24 hours but not now has a row with Telemetry missing.

targets.expr: group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "service.version") (last_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[1m])) * on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") group_left () max by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (last_over_time({"altinn.operator.leader", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[1m]))

group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (present_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[24h])) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") group by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner") (present_over_time({"altinn.workload.start_time", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[2m]))

panels.title: Clusters by operator version
panels.description: Service owner clusters running each operator version (service.version), stacked. An upgrade rolls out ring by ring through the upgrade channels, so a new version's band grows in steps. A cluster counts under both versions while it rolls out.

panels.title: Runs per second by controller
panels.description: Controller runs per second: reconciles of the event-driven controllers (maskinporten, secretsync, appcodesync) and passes of the periodic syncs, from altinn.operator.run.duration. Select a series to search that controller's traces; tail sampling keeps every failed or slow trace and 10 % of the others.

panels.title: Failed runs per second by controller and error type
panels.description: Failed runs per second by controller and error.type, the step that failed (get_source_secret, ensure_helm_release, update_status, …). Select a series to search its failed traces; tail sampling keeps every trace with an error.

links.title: Failed traces of this controller and error type

panels.title: Run duration (p95) by controller
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of successful runs per controller, from altinn.operator.run.duration's buckets (5 ms to 60 s; a run over 60 s shows as 60 s). A periodic sync's run covers all its work in one pass, such as every mapping or every app.

panels.title: Failed runs by service owner
panels.description: Failed runs over the time range by service owner, controller and error.type. Complete: from the metric, not from sampled traces.

panels.title: Stalled syncs
panels.description: Periodic syncs that completed a run in the last 7 days but none without an error recently, per service owner: 30 minutes for the syncs that poll every 5 to 10 minutes (grafanapolicysync, cnpgsync, inactivityscaler, azurekeyvaultsync), 25 hours for the daily maskinporten_rotation_rollout. The sync fails every time or has stopped. A sync that isn't enabled in a cluster never runs there and isn't listed; one that was disabled, or a decommissioned cluster, stays listed for 7 days.

targets.expr: (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"grafanapolicysync|cnpgsync|inactivityscaler|azurekeyvaultsync", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[7d])) > 0) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "error.type"="", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"grafanapolicysync|cnpgsync|inactivityscaler|azurekeyvaultsync", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[30m])) > 0) or (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"maskinporten_rotation_rollout", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[7d])) > 0) unless on ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (sum by ("deployment.environment.name", "altinn.service_owner", "altinn.operator.controller") (increase_pure({"altinn.operator.run.duration_count", "error.type"="", "altinn.operator.controller"=~"maskinporten_rotation_rollout", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[25h])) > 0)

panels.title: Maskinporten clients by state
panels.description: MaskinportenClients across the selected clusters by their Ready condition: ready, not_ready (the last reconcile failed, also a transient failure) or unknown (not reconciled yet). From altinn.operator.maskinporten.clients, which only the leader reports.

panels.title: Clusters with clients not ready
panels.description: Service owner clusters with MaskinportenClients that aren't ready at the range end. not_ready follows a failed reconcile, also a transient one, and the app's existing credentials keep working until they expire. The failed reconciles and their error types are in Failed runs by service owner (controller maskinporten) and in the traces below.

panels.title: Kubernetes API calls per second by status code
panels.description: The operator's calls to the Kubernetes API per second by status code, including leader-election lease renewals and informer lists outside the runs. Watches aren't counted: they're long-lived connections. 404 and 409 are often expected: an object that's gone, or an update conflict that is retried.

panels.title: External calls per second
panels.description: Calls per second to everything but the Kubernetes API: Maskinporten, the org registry, and each cluster's Grafana (one line for all).

panels.title: Failed external calls per second
panels.description: External calls per second that failed, by target and by status code (a 4xx or 5xx response) or error.type (a transport error, such as net.OpError for a refused connection or a timeout).

panels.title: Outgoing call latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile time to the response headers per target, the Kubernetes API included.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (target, le) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(increase_pure({"http.client.request.duration_bucket", "service.name"="operator", "deployment.environment.name"=~"$env", "altinn.service_owner"=~"$service_owner"}[$__rate_interval]), "target", "$1", "server.address", "(.*)"), "target", "Grafana (service owner's)", "server.address", ".*grafana.*"), "target", "Kubernetes API", "server.address", "[0-9.]+|kubernetes.*")))

panels.title: Clusters by inactivity state
panels.description: Non-prod clusters by the state the inactivity scaler last applied, stacked: normal, ttd_offhours (ttd's apps scaled down outside working hours), no_apps (no apps deployed, the gateway and pdf3 relay scaled down) or both. From altinn.operator.inactivityscaler.applied_state; the scaler doesn't run in prod. At a change of state a cluster counts under both for about a minute.

panels.title: Inactivity state by service owner
panels.description: The state each cluster's inactivity scaler last applied at the range end, and whether an override (the inactivity-scaler-override ConfigMap) forced it. Right after a change of state the cluster can have two rows for up to 2 minutes.

panels.title: Failed runs (traces)
panels.description: Failed controller runs per second, from their entry spans with status error. Tail sampling keeps every trace with an error, so this is close to complete; each dot is an example trace to open.

panels.title: Failures by controller, error type and object
panels.description: Failed runs over the time range by environment, service owner, controller, error.type and the Kubernetes object the run worked on, from the stored spans (altinn-studio-traces-logsql). Close to complete, as tail sampling keeps every failed trace.

panels.title: Recent failed runs
panels.description: The latest failed controller runs with the status description (the error message), newest first. Select a trace to open it; the run's "Controller run failed" ERROR log has the same trace ID.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="operator"} "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:altinn.operator.controller":* status_code:2 | sort by (_time desc) limit 200 | fields _time, "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name", "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner", name, "span_attr:error.type", status_message, "span_attr:altinn.app", "span_attr:altinn.operator.object.name", duration, trace_id | rename trace_id as trace
